senses.gloss: f. (אבק, cmp. אבך, חבק; v. Sachs Beitr. I, p. 62; Naḥm. to Gen. XXXII, 25) [bundle of twigs], torch (with, or without של אור).
units: <cite ref="Sotah 21a:8">Sot. 21ᵃ</cite> <he>נזדמנה לו א׳ של אור</he> a burning torch happened to come in his possession.
<cite ref="Berakhot 43b:7">Ber. 43ᵇ</cite> <he>א׳ כשנים</he> walking by torchlight is equal to two walking together (as regards protection from night-spirits).—Pl. <he>אֲבוּקוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Sukkah 4:2">Tosef. Succ. IV, 2</cite> were dancing before them <he>בא׳</he> with torches.

<cite ref="Tosefta Sukkah 4:4">Ib. 4</cite> <he>בשמונה א׳ של אור</he>; <cite ref="Sukkah 53a:7">Succ. 53ᵃ</cite> <he>ח׳ א׳ של אור</he>; Y. ib. V, 55ᶜ top <he>א׳ של זהב</he> (corr. acc. or read <he>זֶפֶת</he>?); Mish.
